title: 研究声音的建筑师  (The Acoustic Architect)

segments.t: Out beneath the old shade tree in the courtyard, Hao opens his brown leather notebook for Qing and Mei while morning birds sing overhead. Listen first.
仔细看这一页——记的是分贝和安静度，不是酒店星级！
分贝？所以九分不是给我前台服务打的分？
你的服务值得十分！其实我是声学建筑师。
声学建筑师！您设计音乐厅吗？
主要设计小图书馆和院子，测量老石墙怎么挡住街上噪音。
难怪昨晚您在阁楼听街上有没有汽车声！
没错。外面大街很吵，进了院子却只听见树叶和小鸟。
等周经理听说他为分贝慌了一整夜，表情一定精彩！
说实话，我选这一带，也是为了一桩家里的旧事。
哦？您家里人以前住在这附近吗？
小时候就住隔两条街。星期五对我来说……是重要日子。
等等——他刚才是不是说了星期五？！
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
仔细看这一页——记的是分贝和安静度，不是酒店星级！
'Look closely at this page—it records decibels and quietness, not hotel stars!'
分贝？所以九分不是给我前台服务打的分？
'Decibels? So nine points was not a score for my front-desk service?'
你的服务值得十分！其实我是声学建筑师。
'Your service deserves ten points! Actually, I am an acoustic architect.'
声学建筑师！您设计音乐厅吗？
'An acoustic architect! Do you design concert halls?'
主要设计小图书馆和院子，测量老石墙怎么挡住街上噪音。
'Mostly small libraries and courtyards, measuring how old stone walls block street noise.'
难怪昨晚您在阁楼听街上有没有汽车声！
'No wonder you listened in the attic last night for car sounds from the street!'
没错。外面大街很吵，进了院子却只听见树叶和小鸟。
'Exactly. Outside on the main road it is noisy, yet inside the courtyard you only hear leaves and birds.'
等周经理听说他为分贝慌了一整夜，表情一定精彩！
'Wait until Manager Zhou hears he panicked all night over decibels!'
说实话，我选这一带，也是为了一桩家里的旧事。
'Honestly, I also chose this neighbourhood for an old family matter.'
哦？您家里人以前住在这附近吗？
'Oh? Did your family live near here once?'
小时候就住隔两条街。星期五对我来说……是重要日子。
'Two streets over, when I was little. Friday for me... is an important day.'
等等——他刚才是不是说了星期五？！
'Wait—did he just say Friday?!'
Now let's listen to the whole conversation one last time.

Hao is an acoustic architect—and his quiet mention of living two streets away and Friday made Qing and Mei exchange a wide-eyed look. See you next time.
